title: Phase 2 Second Review & v10.0 Protocol Re-Audit — Candidate Workspace & Navigation (Re-evaluating DIR-002, DIR-004, DIR-009, DIR-011)
spec:
# DIR-030: Phase 2 Second Review & v10.0 Protocol Re-Audit — Candidate Workspace & Navigation

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
Candidate journey excellence is paramount to ResumePilotAI's retention and conversion. This directive executes the Second Review of DIR-002 (Sub-surfaces & ContextSwitcher), DIR-004 (Zero-FOUC & Hydration), DIR-009 (Candidate Dashboard & Banner Purge), and DIR-011 (Universal AppHeader & Command Surface) under the v10.0 protocol.

The goal is to eliminate any residual duplicate banners, certify zero theme flashing on load, guarantee responsive navigation across all mobile breakpoints, and verify the universal command surface.

## 2. Re-Audit Scope & Architectural Verification
1. **Candidate Dashboard Overhaul (DIR-009 Re-Audit)**:
   - Ensure all duplicate banners, redundant promotional cards, and outdated alerts are eradicated.
   - Validate live metrics: Resume Score, Applications Sent, Profile Views, Interview Invites.
   - Test recent activity feed, quick resume action cards, and recommended jobs widget.

2. **Universal AppHeader & Command Surface (DIR-011 Re-Audit)**:
   - Audit AppHeader across Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, and Admin portals.
   - Verify user avatar dropdown: Profile, Settings, Billing, Theme Toggle, Sign Out.
   - Test notification bell: live unread count, popover drawer, mark-as-read, and link routing.
   - Test ⌘K / Ctrl+K Command Palette: search speed, action execution, and keyboard trap avoidance.

3. **Hydration & Theme Stability (DIR-004 Re-Audit)**:
   - Measure First Contentful Paint (FCP) and CLS in dark mode on cold cache.
   - Confirm zero dark-to-light theme flashing across all Candidate sub-routes.

4. **Candidate Sub-Surfaces (DIR-002 Re-Audit)**:
   - Test Profile edit tabs, Work preferences, Resume manager, and Job applications tracker.

## 3. Acceptance Criteria
1. Candidate Dashboard renders cleanly with zero duplicate banners or visual clutter.
2. Universal AppHeader is responsive, displays live notification badges, and has fully accessible dropdowns.
3. Command Palette (⌘K) opens in < 50ms, indexes all routes/actions, and navigates seamlessly.
4. Cold reload in dark mode produces zero FOUC or color inversion flashes.
5. All Candidate sub-surfaces function cleanly on mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1440px).
6. Real browser crawl verifies 100% working interactive controls with zero dead links.

## 4. Strict Invariants
1. Never compromise candidate authentication session or JWT refresh lifecycle.
2. Notification polling or websocket sync must not consume excessive CPU or network bandwidth.
3. Retain zero layout shift (CLS < 0.05) across all candidate pages.
4. WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for all interactive controls and focus states.
invariants: Preserve candidate authentication and session persistence
Zero layout shift (CLS < 0.05) on all candidate route transitions
Notification polling/socket must implement exponential backoff on errors
All dropdowns and modals must implement standard WAI-ARIA keyboard patterns
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate dashboard is unified, uncluttered, and displays verified real-time metrics
AppHeader functions identically and responsively across all portal roles
Universal Command Palette (⌘K) operates with instant keyboard shortcuts
Zero FOUC verified on cold-cache dark mode reloads
Full responsive verification on 375px, 768px, and 1440px viewports
